field_principles.beats_cpu_trie: True only when CSR is faster while preserving exact mask validity.
field_principles.beats_rerank_only_on_validity_or_cost: True when constrained masks beat rerank-only on validity or equal-validity cost.
field_principles.csr_latency_ms: Mean CSR/vectorized mask lookup latency per prefix in milliseconds.
field_principles.duration_s: Wall-clock runtime for deterministic mask extraction and artifact assembly.
field_principles.finite_schema: The bounded verifier verdict schema and canonical JSON/token rules.
field_principles.flagged_adversarial: True only for self-detected artifact inconsistency.
field_principles.honest_verdict: Terminal prefix: success only for CSR speedup plus validity/cost win; otherwise complete no-headline diagnostic.
field_principles.inference_substrate: Declares deterministic_static_csr_mask_benchmark unless a real live smoke is invoked.
field_principles.live_llm_invoked: True only when a live endpoint smoke actually ran.
field_principles.mask_speedup: Trie latency divided by CSR latency; above one means CSR is faster.
field_principles.model_specs: The three mandated GGUF model IDs plus any resolved Exp5085 paths.
field_principles.n_allowed_outputs: Number of exact canonical outputs in the finite language.
field_principles.preconditions_checked: Records selected schema, byte-token assumptions, and Exp5085 endpoint usability.
field_principles.rerank_only_validity_rate: Post-generation rerank-only validity on candidate batches.
field_principles.trie_latency_ms: Mean CPU trie mask lookup latency per prefix in milliseconds.
field_principles.validity_rate: Fraction of constrained finite outputs accepted by the masks.
